name: io.github.sectersion/polymer
title: Polymer
description: Fleet coordination and observability for autonomous coding agents. A shared task board with transactional leases and fencing (claim, don't wait), @mention handoffs, and OpenTelemetry-native telemetry with server-side per-agent/per-task cost attribution. Self-hosted: Node/TS MCP server (Streamable HTTP), REST API, SQLite, and a Next.js admin console.
